title: Fresh Approval Wrapper Clearance Preview
claim: A fresh ChatGPT session could invoke the exposed guarded next-gate wrapper with a fresh valid approval and receive a clearance-preview manifest without host blocking or operational side effects.
summary: Record that FP-MCP-335 validated approval allowed forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate to apply the PREVIEW_CLEARANCE wrapper phase. caveats: This does not reach final guarded execution.
boundaries: No files written by the wrapper.
observedResult: A fresh ChatGPT session could invoke the exposed guarded next-gate wrapper with a fresh valid approval and receive a clearance-preview manifest without host blocking or operational side effects.
